title: Impact fees; director's consent.
bodyText: Notwithstanding section 264-123, no county shall assess impact fees for state highway improvements without the director’s consent.
bodyHtml: [§264-124  Impact fees; director's consent.]  Notwithstanding section 264-123, no county shall assess impact fees for state highway improvements without the director’s consent. [L 2004, c 155, pt of §2]
